capabilities: Assign one of 12 colors to folders or notes from the right-click menu
Tint item names and show a colored dot in the file explorer
Remove color labels from the same menu
Persist colors across restarts, renames, and moves
Pick colors via a swatch dialog on mobile
disambiguation: Not a text highlighter for note content; it colors item names and dots in the file explorer only.
extras: Colors are stored in the plugin's own data.json keyed by vault path; note content is never modified. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no built-in way to visually highlight important folders or notes with colors.
summary: File-explorer plugin that marks folders and notes with one of 12 calendar-style color labels via the right-click context menu.
